title: Crestline Corporate Travel Agreements — Price of a Domestic Main Cabin Round-Trip Award in Company Points
content:
**Price statement.** A domestic Crestline Main Cabin round-trip award redeemed from the company points of a Crestline Corporate Travel Agreements agreement is priced at the standard domestic award price: the tier's domestic Main Cabin round-trip award points, charged as listed. The points redeemed for the award are that price, in whole points.

### Worked figure (hypothetical)

On a tier whose domestic Main Cabin round-trip award points are 1600, the award is charged 1600 points, and the award-ticket redemption entry carries 1600 points.

### Point of judgement

The price is the same for every roster traveler named as the beneficiary; it attaches to the award, not to the traveler.
